# Canonical numbers

**Generated by `python3 canonical.py` — do not hand-edit.** Every figure
below is recomputed from cached out-of-fold predictions with the official
scorer (`src/validate.score_trajectory`), so any citation elsewhere can be
checked by re-running this script.

Commit: `79afabe`

**Metric convention.** Each per-horizon RMSE is computed exactly as
`evaluation_procedure.pdf` defines it — pooled over every valid
county-hour cell of that horizon — and a verbatim re-implementation in
submission-file space reproduces all four to machine precision. The
`mean` column is *ours*, not theirs: the organisers rank within each
horizon and average the four ranks, ties broken on t01h, so they never
form a single number. We report the mean because a scalar is needed to
compare configurations, and it is safe wherever one configuration wins
on all four horizons — which is checked in SUBMISSION.md. MAE is not
scored by the organisers at all; it is a diagnostic. Production
headlines were briefly quoted from the `t01h` row instead — that is the
REPORT §5ap correction, and it is why this file exists.

## Shipped configuration and alternatives

The four RMSE_k columns are what the organisers actually score. `mean`
is our own aggregation and has no official standing -- ranking is by
average *rank* across the four, ties broken on t01h.
